title: Communicating with (out) code
summary: I occasionally receive a piece in my feed about why it's not such a good idea to use AI for writing. The first one to catch my attention was an Oxide's request for discussion on using LLMs. The document describes a "social contract" underlying all written communication, and how hints of AI usage will undermine the reader's trust:
